name: ShieldCortex Real-time Scanner
description: Real-time defence scanning on LLM input, memory extraction on LLM output, and active tool call interception with approval gating.

engines.conversationGateNote: The before_agent_run gate (conversation firewall enforcement) first appears in OpenClaw 2026.5.9-beta.1 and first ships stable in 2026.5.12; 2026.5.7 has no such hook. Below that floor the hook registration is silently dropped by the host, so the plugin reports the conversation plane as observation-only rather than claiming enforcement. Everything else in this plugin still works at the `openclaw` floor above.

binaryPath.label: ShieldCortex Binary Path
binaryPath.help: Optional absolute path to the shieldcortex CLI when it is not on PATH.

cloudApiKey.label: Cloud API Key
cloudApiKey.help: Optional ShieldCortex Cloud API key used for realtime threat forwarding.

cloudBaseUrl.label: Cloud Base URL
cloudBaseUrl.help: Override the ShieldCortex Cloud API base URL if you use a self-hosted or staging endpoint.

openclawAutoMemory.label: Auto Memory Extraction
openclawAutoMemory.help: Extract high-signal decisions and learnings from LLM output into ShieldCortex memory.

openclawAutoMemoryDedupe.label: Dedupe Auto Memory
openclawAutoMemoryDedupe.help: Skip near-duplicate memories before they are written to ShieldCortex.

openclawAutoMemoryNoveltyThreshold.label: Novelty Threshold
openclawAutoMemoryNoveltyThreshold.help: Similarity threshold for duplicate suppression. Higher values keep more memories.

openclawAutoMemoryMaxRecent.label: Recent Memory Cache Size
openclawAutoMemoryMaxRecent.help: How many recent extracted memories to keep in the dedupe cache.

interceptor.enabled.label: Enable Tool Call Interceptor
interceptor.enabled.description: Scan memory-write tool calls and gate suspicious content behind user approval

interceptor.severityActions.high.label: High Severity Action
interceptor.severityActions.high.description: Action for high-severity threats (log, warn, require_approval)

interceptor.severityActions.critical.label: Critical Severity Action
interceptor.severityActions.critical.description: Action for critical-severity threats (log, warn, require_approval)

interceptor.actionGuard.enabled.label: Action Guard
interceptor.actionGuard.enabled.description: Gate dangerous shell/file/network/git tool calls before they execute. Catastrophic operations are always blocked while enabled.

interceptor.actionGuard.enforce.label: Enforce Action Guard
interceptor.actionGuard.enforce.description: Enforce dangerous-operation gating (attended: approval prompt; unattended: failurePolicy). Off = warn-and-allow (advisory). Catastrophic operations block regardless.

interceptor.actionGuard.autoApprove.label: Action Guard Auto-approve List
interceptor.actionGuard.autoApprove.description: Family/action/signal names pre-approved for unattended agents that legitimately need specific dangerous operations (case-insensitive substring match). Never applies to catastrophic operations.

interceptor.actionGuard.auditAllows.label: Audit Recognised Allows
interceptor.actionGuard.auditAllows.description: Write an audit entry when the guard evaluates a recognised (sensitive-tier) operation and allows it, so forensics can distinguish scanned-and-allowed from never-scanned. Benign allows are never audited.

interceptor.actionGuard.broker.enabled.label: AI Approval Broker
interceptor.actionGuard.broker.enabled.description: Let a fast model judge dangerous-tier approvals before they reach you: it can deny outright when it sees injection, and release reversible, in-context, high-confidence actions without waiting. Never applies to catastrophic operations. Off by default.

interceptor.actionGuard.broker.allowPreC.label: Allow Broker Pre-clear
interceptor.actionGuard.broker.allowPreC.description: Off = every dangerous-tier action still waits for you; the broker can then only harden, never release.

interceptor.conversation.posture.label: Conversation Firewall
interceptor.conversation.posture.description: What the conversation firewall does with a detection on the input path. off = do not scan; observe = scan, audit and alert the operator but never stop the turn (default); enforce = block the run via before_agent_run. Requires plugins.entries.shieldcortex-realtime.hooks.allowConversationAccess=true on this host — OpenClaw refuses conversation hooks without that operator grant, and ShieldCortex will never set it for you.

interceptor.actionGuard.notify.enabled.label: Operator Notifications
interceptor.actionGuard.notify.enabled.description: Reach a human when the guard holds an action, or when the conversation firewall detects a threat. Off by default.

interceptor.actionGuard.notify.webhookUr.label: Notify Webhook URL
interceptor.actionGuard.notify.webhookUr.description: http(s) endpoint the notification is POSTed to. Conversation-firewall alerts carry no approve/deny affordance — there is nothing to approve.

interceptor.actionGuard.notify.webhookSe.label: Notify Webhook Secret
interceptor.actionGuard.notify.webhookSe.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for X-ShieldCortex-Signature, so the receiver can reject spoofed POSTs.

interceptor.actionGuard.notify.openclaw.label: Notify via OpenClaw
interceptor.actionGuard.notify.openclaw.description: Deliver through the gateway's own channel where the runtime provides that seam.

enabled.description: Unused — plugin on/off is controlled by plugins.entries[id].enabled on the host, not this nested config value. See #115.

trustOwnerInput.description: Default true: a message the host attributes to the gateway OWNER is an instruction, so a detection in it is audited and alerted but never taints the session or blocks the turn. Set false on a host where the owner routinely pastes untrusted content and you would rather have the caution than the quiet. Content from anyone else — including another agent on a trusted channel — is data regardless of this setting.

posture.description: off = do not scan the conversation; observe = scan, audit and alert but never block (default); enforce = block the run on a dirty verdict via before_agent_run. Requires hooks.allowConversationAccess=true on this host.

broker.description: AI-assisted approval broker (#143). Off unless enabled is exactly true. normaliseBrokerConfig in the main package still has the last word on every value here, so anything that slips past this schema is still range-checked and dropped before the broker sees it.

notify.description: Operator-notify transport (#143), also used by the conversation firewall’s detection sink (#225). Off unless enabled is exactly true.

reviewedScripts.description: Reviewed-script allowlist (#189). Each entry pins ONE script by absolute path and content hash; createReviewedScriptCheck has the last word on every field.
